name: Web Noose
disable: DC 19 Survival check (trained) or DC 19 Thievery check (expert) to rearrange the webbing

items.name: Web Noose
items.text:
A creature steps into the square in which the web noose is set

---
Effect The trap makes a noose Strike against the triggering creature.

text: A looped length of webbing snags a creature that walks into it and yanks them painfully off the ground.
